title: Map Users and Mapmakers: The Scope of Cognitive Attribution from Acquired Representations
abstract: arXiv:2609.13879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An acquired representation can enlarge a system's cognitive repertoire without transferring the capacities exercised in producing that representation. This paper develops a framework for specifying that enlargement and its limits. Its central contribution is a five-part attribution table distinguishing effective tracking, application of acquired structures, acquisition from explicit specifications, acquisition from identifying observations, and retention and reuse. Each entry identifies a positive capacity commitment and a further claim requiring additional support. The argument deliberately grants meaningful content, causal efficacy, and productive inference, so that its conclusion does not depend on treating representations as inert encodings. Map and category examples show why even complete application competence leaves acquisition capacity undetermined, and why acquiring a criterion from its description differs from finding it in exa

translated_title: 地图使用者与地图绘制者：从习得表征进行认知归因的范围
translated_abstract: 习得表征可以在不转移产生该表征时所运用的能力的情况下，扩大一个系统的认知储备。本文提出了一个用于界定这种扩大及其限制的框架。其核心贡献是一个五部分归因表，区分了有效追踪、习得结构的应用、从明确规范中的习得、从识别性观察中的习得，以及保留与复用。每一项都指出了一个积极的能力承诺，以及一个需要额外支持的进一步主张。该论证有意赋予表征有意义的内容、因果效力和生产性推理，因此其结论并不依赖于将表征视为惰性编码。地图和范畴的例子说明了为什么即使具备完全的应用能力，习得能力仍无法确定，以及为什么从描述中获得一个标准与在例子中发现该标准有所不同。
tldr: 本文提出了一个五部分归因表框架，用于精确界定习得表征对系统认知能力的扩大范围及其限制，并通过地图和范畴的例子说明具备应用能力并不等于具备习得能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a five-part attribution table framework for specifying the scope and limits of cognitive enlargement from acquired representations, using map and category examples to show that complete application competence does not determine acquisition capacity.
